title: Santos Limited - proposed acquisition of Queensland Gas Company Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced public review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC requested further information from Santos. ACCC timeline suspended.
Proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings delayed to allow consultation on Statement of Issues.
Proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings delayed pending further information from Santos.
ACCC received further information from Santos. ACCC timeline recommenced.
Santos announces a new takeover proposal for QGC and that it will let the previous takeover proposal lapse.
Proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings. In light of Santos' new proposal the ACCC announced that it would not be making a formal decision on the previous takeover proposal.
ACCC establishes a timeline for market inquiries in relation to Santos' new proposal.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties in relation to the new proposal. Submissions must be received by 9:00 a.m.
ACCC announced its decision to oppose the proposed acquisition.
